description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users and about 1,900 cross-division station accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every business system in every division federates to SYS-G1; without sign-in, work orders, clearances, dosimetry, and manifests stop. CDAs do not use SYS-G1
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; station CDA accounts are local to the CSP boundary and unaffected
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every business process below; not used by CDAs (SYS-N4, SYS-N5)

business_process: Cloud landing zones, wide-area network, and remote access
description: Network hubs, guardrails, keys, logging, site links, and the remote access service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The work management system, dosimetry system, and division workloads run behind the hubs; station business networks reach them over the WAN
manual_workaround: Station-local file caches; dosimetry results can be released by courier in an emergency
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Cloud platform and network operations teams
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Work management (SYS-N2), dosimetry (SYS-E3), engineering (SYS-E1), waste tracking interfaces

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and incident handling for business systems; liaison to each station CST
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: NRC 73.77 clocks (1, 4, and 8 hours), CIP-008 (1 hour), Part 37 (4 hours), and Form 8-K timing all depend on the SOC and the CSTs establishing facts quickly
manual_workaround: Station CSTs keep independent CDA monitoring; retainer firm tooling
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every notice in P08; the CSTs rely on the SOC for business-network evidence of attempted pivots

description: Emergency Notification System (ENS) calls, 50.72 and 73.77 notifications, and ERDS activation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 50.72(a)(3): no later than 1 hour after declaring an emergency class; 73.77(a)(1): within 1 hour; ERDS within 1 hour of an Alert or higher (50.72(a)(4))
manual_workaround: ENS and commercial telephone backups per 73.77(c)(1); printed contact lists in each control room. Not dependent on the business network
dependent_systems: ENS and commercial telephone (outside all IT systems); SYS-N4 for ERDS
dependent_third_parties: Telephone carriers; NRC Headquarters Operations Center
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Independent of SYS-G1 to SYS-G3 by design; the group matrix (P08) tells the station when a business-network event may be reportable

description: Generator Operator dispatch, telemetry, and communications with the Transmission Operator and Balancing Authority for all 5 units
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: NERC CIP medium impact control center; loss of dispatch communications must be covered by the backup control center
manual_workaround: Backup control center at Station A; voice dispatch by recorded line
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses a separate ESP and its own identity store, not SYS-G1

description: Equipment isolation and tagging that protects workers during maintenance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Worker safety: no new clearance can be issued without tag records; existing clearances stay hung and are verified in the field
manual_workaround: Paper clearance process with pre-printed forms and controlled tag stock (procedure tested each outage)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on SYS-G1 sign-in and the SYS-G3 WAN to the cloud-hosted work management system

description: Schedule, work packages, and status for about 12,000 outage work orders per refueling outage
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Each lost outage day costs about $1.7 million in lost generation for a 1,150 MW unit; work packages cannot be printed or closed
manual_workaround: Printed work packages for the next 48 hours of critical path; manual status boards
dependent_people_or_facilities: Outage control center; about 900 Engineering and Radiation Services staff and Radioactive Waste Management crews
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Engineering and Radiation Services and Radioactive Waste Management crews work from these packages

business_process: Site access processing for outage workers
description: Business-side processing of access requests, training records, and contractor/vendor certifications before the security organization grants unescorted access
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: An outage needs about 2,500 workers badged in the first week; 73.56 decisions cannot be made without records
manual_workaround: Manual processing of certified contractor/vendor packets; escort for limited work
dependent_third_parties: Industry personnel access data system; Engineering and Radiation Services contractor/vendor program
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-ER05 certifications from Engineering and Radiation Services

description: The division's 73.56 contractor/vendor program: background investigations, certifications, and records for outage workers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Licensee outages (group and 14 external utilities) need certifications before badging
manual_workaround: Manual certification letters for urgent workers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds BP-NG05 and external utilities' access programs

description: Engineering and health physics support during outages, using station business network accounts
process_owner: Engineering and Radiation Services outage services director
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supports the outage critical path at group and client stations
manual_workaround: On-site engineers work from printed packages
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 900 staff at group stations per year
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Cross-division accounts on SYS-N1 and SYS-N2 (scenario gap 1)

description: Intrusion detection, PACS, and video for the category 2 sealed source vault
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 37.49(a)(1) requires continuous monitoring and detection, or an alarm and response when it is lost; compensatory measures start at once
manual_workaround: Armed or unarmed guard posted at the vault per the security plan; alarm company notified
dependent_people_or_facilities: Facility security staff; local law enforcement
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Today shares the facility business network (scenario gap 7)

business_process: Hazmat transport dispatch and shipment tracking
